The '''Blue Cliffs''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endoraan]]. Passengers aboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] were able to visit the Blue Cliffs and enjoy roasted [[quialeg]].<ref name="ACPOV" />
